I made AI Code Rating. It's three characters that tell you who maintains a project, how much of its code AI wrote, and how closely a person checked it.

A2b = expert maintainer, 26–50% AI-written, every AI change reviewed.
B0a = experienced maintainer, no AI code.

It goes in an ACR.md file in your repo. It doesn't judge whether using AI is good or bad.

https://aicoderating.com
